# v2026.11.9

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.9.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.9.md).

This release covers **2 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Jobs get their Seazona invoice lines, such as Shipping/Handling and Rush, when Flow's copy missed the invoice. ([#511](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/511))

## Changes

- Each sweep run reads the invoice of up to 25 orders whose invoice is not in Flow's copy, by the order's own id. ([#511](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/511))

## Fixes

- A job no longer shows only the order's products when Seazona invoiced it with service lines. A job already drafted or sent shows the change for a person. ([#511](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/511))
